title: Transforming Neighbourhood Shops to Provide Employment Opportunities to Persons with Special Needs
what_it_is: Transforming Neighbourhood Shops to Provide Employment Opportunities to Persons with Special Needs

sections.label: Open Door and Inclusive Business Programmes
sections.summary: Under the Open Door Programme, SG Enable gives job matching and support, and the Inclusive Business Programme allocates HDB shop spaces to businesses hiring at least 20% persons with disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Under the Open Door Programme, administered by SG Enable, persons with disabilities and employers receive up to one year of job matching and customised employment support from trained job coaches.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Employers can tap on the Job Redesign Grant to redesign jobs, purchase new equipment or modify the workplace to be more conducive for their employees with disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: In addition, under the Inclusive Business Programme run by the Housing and Development Board (HDB) and SG Enable, businesses that commit to having at least 20% of their hired workforce made up of persons with disabilities can be directly allocated HDB shop spaces.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: SMEs enjoy a 30% rental discount for their first three years of tenancy, with an option to renew for another three years.

sections.label: Inclusive employment strategy components
sections.summary: The strategies include enhancing employer support in six growth sectors, improving gig work opportunities for PwDs, and uplifting job coach capabilities, and reviewing the Enabling Business Hub.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: Some of the key components of our strategies to raise the bar in inclusive employment include: one, harvesting the potential for more inclusive hires in six identified growth sectors by enhancing support for employers in companies in these sectors, including putting in place inclusive hiring champions; two, improving opportunities for PwDs in gig work; and three, uplifting the capabilities of our job coaches.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: But to the Member's suggestion, we are prepared to look at what the Enabling Business Hub is currently doing, working with the hawkers' associations, as well as the local community, local heartlands, business owners, and scale what has been done, where appropriate.
